2609.21619.title: Calibrating Teacher--Student Discrepancy for On-Policy Distillation
2609.21619.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by learning the token-level discrepancy between a stronger teacher and an on-policy student. However, this discrepancy does not purely reflect the capability gap between the teacher and the student: it also contains deviations arising from the teacher itself, which are consequently mixed into the observed teacher--student discrepancy and indiscriminately learned by standard OPD during training. This issue is further exacerbated by privileged OPD, where privileged information induces larger teacher-side likelihood shifts, thereby encouraging the student to learn more of the teacher's own deviation. We introduce \textbf{Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (Cal-OPD)}, which estimates the teacher's self-deviation region through positive and negative privileged interventions and calibrates the original teacher--student discrepancy by retaining only the component that lies beyond this region. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that, while retaining only about 52--65\% of the original teacher--student discrepancy as the optimization signal, Cal-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD and its variants across model scales.
2609.21619.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，透過學習強大教師與在政策學生之間的標記級差異來改善推理模型。 然而，這種差異並不僅僅反映教師與學生之間的能力差距：它還包含來自教師自身的偏差，這些偏差因此混入觀察到的教師-學生差異中，並在訓練期間被標準 OPD 不加區別地學習。 這個問題在特權 OPD 中進一步加劇，因為特權信息會引起更大的教師端可能性變化，從而促使學生學習更多教師自身的偏差。 我們引入了 \textbf{校準政策蒸餾（Cal-OPD）}，它通過正向和負向的特權干預來估計教師的自我偏差區域，並通過僅保留位於此區域之外的組件來校準原始教師-學生差異。 在數學推理基準上的實驗顯示，雖然僅保留約 52-65\% 的原始教師-學生差異作為優化信號，但 Cal-OPD 在各種模型規模中始終優於標準 OPD 及其變體。
